note: Controlled vocabulary for the themes map. A research child may propose a new id with new: true; the parent reviews it at ingest.

themes.name: Time
themes.line: Structure as subject: the order you learn things in is the story.

themes.name: Memory
themes.line: What a character cannot remember, or cannot stop remembering.

themes.name: Identity
themes.line: Who someone is when the evidence of it is gone or doubled.

themes.name: Obsession
themes.line: A pursuit that costs more than it can return.

themes.name: Deception
themes.line: Tricks played on characters and on the audience, usually at once.

themes.name: Guilt
themes.line: A past act the film circles back to.

themes.name: Grief
themes.line: Loss as the engine of a plot.

themes.name: Sacrifice
themes.line: Someone pays so that others can go on.

themes.name: Fathers and children
themes.line: A parent trying to get home, or a child left behind.

themes.name: Duality
themes.line: Doubles, mirrors, rivals, two halves of one thing.

themes.name: Order and chaos
themes.line: Systems against the people who break them.

themes.name: Faith
themes.line: Acting on something that cannot be proved.

themes.name: Fear
themes.line: What a character is made of when afraid.

themes.name: The machine
themes.line: A device, a method or a weapon that outgrows its maker.

themes.name: Duty
themes.line: Doing the job in front of you, whatever it costs.
